.name: Look up Steam game reviews
.note: Read recent Steam reviews for one AppID, optionally filtered by recommendation and language. By default, the sample uses Steam purchases and excludes off-topic activity. Overall scores appear on the first page of all reviews. Reuse the same filters when continuing with nextCursor.
.description: Read recent Steam reviews for one AppID, optionally filtered by recommendation and language. By default, the sample uses Steam purchases and excludes off-topic activity. Overall scores appear on the first page of all reviews. Reuse the same filters when continuing with nextCursor.
.parameters.reviewType: Use all, positive, or negative. Defaults to all.
.parameters.language: Steam API language code, such as english or schinese. Defaults to all.
.parameters.cursor: Pass the previous nextCursor for the next page. Omit for the first page.
.parameters.limit: 1 to 100 reviews per page. Defaults to 20.
